---
title: "Current implementation and first use"
---

Track work blocks by category with pause/resume, weekly targets and local history. Notification delivery depends on device permissions and power policies.

This page describes the October 2026 source revision. These source changes are not part of older development release downloads. Local checks are distinct from device, live-service and store acceptance.

## Build from a clean checkout

JDK 17, Android SDK 36 and build-tools 35.0.0. Set JAVA_HOME and ANDROID_HOME. A device/emulator is required to install. Open the existing ios/*.xcodeproj in a full Xcode installation for iOS.

```sh
cd android
./gradlew --no-daemon testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug bundleRelease
adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
```

These commands build from this source tree. Debug APKs are development artifacts; release bundles need private signing and device acceptance. A successful build is not a store submission.

## Use and verification

Read the [repository README](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-focus/blob/main/README.md) for the exact application workflow, privacy/storage behavior and platform differences. The [October refinement record](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-focus/blob/main/docs/refinement-2026-10.md) records findings, changes, observed checks, deferred work and the next release action.

Observed remote verification on 2026-10-31: [commit `00e3c5dce3ab`](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-focus/commit/00e3c5dce3ab6207a108ff4f4cd10d9c1f2f8e47) passed [Android tests, lint, debug APK and unsigned release AAB packaging, plus the full unsigned iOS simulator build](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-focus/actions/runs/41200540333). Its [documentation build and deployment](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-focus/actions/runs/41200540311) also passed. Device journeys, live-service acceptance where applicable, release signing and store submission remain separate from these results.
